notes.title: DHXP 2025 Anniversary event
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you for sticking with us all these years![/h1]

It's been over a decade since we began this journey, as this month marks [i]eleven[/i] years of Digital Happiness' first-ever launched title, DreadOut. What started as a small spark has grown into a world of stories and shared memories with you, our beloved players.

Everything we've built was made with passion, sleepless nights, and LOTS of coffee. And through it all, you've been there playing, supporting, and believing in us.

DHXP is the pulse of everything we’ve created so far. And to this day, it has always been more than a celebration, it’s a thank you, a look back, and a vision of what lies ahead.

And for you, thank you for being part of this journey. Whether you’ve been here since the beginning, or you just stumbled into our world someway somehow, we're glad you're here.

[h2]Then what lies beyond the 11th year?[/h2]

This is the fun part. Currently, there are so many things going on in our headquarters, and we're so excited to share them with you. We're working on titles that you might have expected and not expected!

[previewyoutube=uYlkB3py6EE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Also check out the DHXP 2025 Steam Sale Page by clicking the banner below:[/h3]

[url=bit.ly/dhxp2025][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371531/f6f256432d7ba3a4c98fa44749cb058a7bd9463e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Did someone mention sale?[/h2]
Of course, we have a special sale going on too! Take a look around and dive into the games that have shaped us as a developers. You can get it with [b]up to 80% off[/b]!

Please spread the news because this offer lasts through May 24, 2025!

Hope you enjoy every bit of it!

:DH

notes.title: DreadHaunt 1.0 Is Here!
notes.content:
Hello Agents!

We're thrilled to announce that DreadHaunt 1.0 is finally here! After months of hard work, dedication, and countless sleepless nights, we're excited to bring you the full vision of a fun yet scary experience.

This update marks a significant milestone for our team. We've poured our hearts and souls into creating a truly haunting experience, and we can't wait to see what you think.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1855580/DreadHaunt/

[h1]What's New in 1.0?[/h1]

[h2]New Gameplay Modes: Single Player Campaign[/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/c1b8e7ad1ee4eaba9a41b02b44ffca8531011c62.gif[/img]
Experience the thrills of DreadHaunt, if you dare, in Single Player mode, And dive deeper into the DreadHaunt universe with an expanded lore.

[h2]Expanded Character Roster[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/bc528a019a18950415d750d291efbfca4c234bf8.gif[/img]
DreadHaunt 1.0 features a wider selection of playable characters, both Agents and the Spectromorphs will be unlocked as you play.

[h2][b](Free)[/b] Season Pass: Pilot[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/5b790f03cc736971d180b0176f0ada05afc3be72.jpg[/img]
In addition to new modes, agents, and Spectromorphs, you will also rewarded with more agent costumes, lore entries, titles, alternate NPC ghosts, and many more!

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
We couldn't have made it this far without your incredible support. Thank you for joining us on this terrifying journey. We can't wait to see what horrors await you in DreadHaunt 1.0.

Thank you for your support, and get haunting!

- Digital Happiness :DH

notes.title: Red Lantern and Gold Coins - DreadHaunt Update 20240212
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/5a0bf7efea472448e26d4283efffecd923b86b91.png[/img]

Greetings, Agents!

First of all, happy Lunar New Year! And now, the HQ is presenting news regarding DreadHaunt’s latest update, just in time for this festivities!


[h2]Seasonal Environment – CNY[/h2]

Embrace the spirit of the Lunar New Year with the new seasonal ornament! We hope that this seasonal environment will freshen up your haunting sessions. We even managed to snap some footage directly from the field.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/e539ad057f0ae07ccb750d5a5353ad99499acdf5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/56797effdfd5768a62fb2436a7002d8da5bc4d30.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/36f67341665fee32f2548ab3af5b6f6e376f0dd2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/b6f56fbad7faa8340811599c67dda00b88916299.jpg[/img][/url]


[h2]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h2]

As usual, We squashed some bugs and fine-tuned several aspects to ensure smooth gameplay. However, don’t hesitate to reach out if you have feedback and suggestions!


[h2]Future Update Sneak Peek[/h2]

Based on the timeline that we shared, the single-player mode is in the works. We’re also working on the game economy like XP accumulation and cosmetics rewards.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1855580/extras/content_release_plan_fixed.jpg?t=1703069105[/img]

That is all for now. Thank you for your continued support for DreadHaunt!

notes.title: DreadHaunt Update 2023-12-20
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33371531/07d380d2395eacdd707e403d3e5806bfd69af98a.png[/img]
Good day, Agents.

We have updated DreadHaunt to version 20231218, and these are notable details that the HQ want to share:

[h2]Post-Session Results Screen[/h2]

After each session, you’ll be presented with an eye-catching post-result screen. Showing who’s the possessed one, who survived (or didn’t), and how many points you racked up during the mission. 

[h2](Ongoing) Audio Updates[/h2]

We decided to overhaul the Audio System including BGM & SFX assets. You will notice a few changes during gameplay

[h2](Ongoing) Controller Support[/h2]

Controller support is available in very early stage. If you the controller-wielding type of agent, we are looking forward to hear your experiences!

[h2]Bug Fixes, Here and There[/h2]

- Added subtitle size option to Settings.
- Spectro damage effect +15%
- Kunti attack charge 25 -> 28.75
- Asih attack charge 10 -> 11.5
- Prevent drop tools while opening voter
- BugFix: Kunti attack charge hit multiple times
- Add condition to disable host quit button when in game
- add descriptions to sprectro skills
- fix mouse cursor not reappearing during waiting for players

[h2]Known Bugs/Glitches[/h2]

- BGM not playing on Versus Mode
- etc.

[h2]Sneak Peek of Future Contents[/h2]

We have a Content Update Plans on the DreadHaunt store page, check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1855580/DreadHaunt/

Last but not least, if you have any suggestions or experienced bugs or glitches about the game, Feel free to reach us out on Steam Community Forum and our official discord server at discord.gg/dreaduniverse

notes.title: DreadHaunt Playtest is open during Steam Scream Fest!
notes.content:
Hi Agents! 

To commemorate Steam Scream Fest, DreadHaunt Playtest is open until 1 November! 

With this playtest phase. There are some gameplay features you can try, which are:

- Gameplay modifier tarot system. choose several modifiers that will change the vibe of every game session. 

- Preview of the session ending screen and merit points distribution.

- Reworked several possessed abilities.

- QoL update: character & environment polishing. bugfixes, etc

I hope you enjoy the playtest! If you have feedback go to the steam community hub or discord.gg/dreaduniverse. Also, bring your friends to survive together and wishlist DreadHaunt!

notes.title: 75% Off and 2.2.5 Update Released
notes.content:
[img=]http://dreadout.com/images/linda_summer_breeze.jpg[/img]

Yay! 
As we got selected as one of the Special 48 Hours discount, enjoy our special summer breeze sale! 

You can get DreadOut at 75% off while we are featured on the summer sale special for 48 hours.

As for the rest of the summer sale, we are still offering DreadOut at 66% off until the summer sale ends. So, it might be a good time to have your friends experience the horrors in Linda's journey.

Also, remember to update your game to get the best experience playing DreadOut as we routinely fix bugs that are reported to us.
As a recap, here’s what have been updated on our latest build (2.2.5) :
[list] 
[*] Linda will have a new T-shirt than can be unlocked right from the beginning of the game. You can find the outfit through the van's trunk at the beginning of Act 1.
[*] Fixed number of articles related to "Tomb Reader" achievement
[*] Fixed "Book of the Dead" and "Tomb Reader" achievements
[*] Fixed bug where loading the game will bring up the main menu instead
[*] Fixed some ghost glitches where it went freeze but still causing player damage
[/list]

[b]for Mac / Linux users[/b]
There is still an "asset release problem" on Linux and Mac within our engine (using Unity). The workaround is we would have to play from a clean start at almost every next scene/level. We apologise for the inconvenience but that is what works for now.

[i]To recap:[/i]
Start the app (DreadOut), play the game, finish current level, when the level is finished, it will advance to the next level which will mostly fail (because of the reason above). Just quit the app, wait for Steam to synchronise the cloud files, then start the app again, then load the game from the slot we use. Repeat for the next level. Again, apologies for the inconvenience.

Thank you for your kind attention.
Hope you all are having a wonderful summer. ☺

DH

notes.title: DreadOut version 2.0.0 Released
notes.content:
[img]http://www.dreadout.com/act2.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,

We're happy to announce that DreadOut version 2.0.0 is available now. This new version brings Act 2 to DreadOut, with some of the biggest highlights being:
[olist][*]DreadOut Act 2 is released, as a free update for DreadOut game.[/*][*]DreadOut Act 2 adds 22 new Steam achievements, and some more soundtracks[/*][*]These new additional soundtracks also added to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/298680/]DreadOut Soundtrack & Manga DLC[/url][/*][/olist]

Happy Valentine, Linda loves you all!

[b]Digital Happiness[/b]

We're happy to announce that DreadOut version 1.9.0 is available now. This new version brings major updates to DreadOut, with some of the biggest highlights being:
[olist][*]DreadOut engine is updated to prepare for our upcoming Act 2 release.[/*][*]DreadOut Act 0 Prologue (which is also available separately as DreadOut Demo) is now integrated with the main game.[/*][/olist]
DreadOut Act 0 Prologue / Demo can be seen as an integral part of DreadOut story, so if you guys have not played the Demo yet, you can now revisit Linda's nightmare as a prologue for the Act 1 directly from the main menu.

[b]Release Notes[/b]:
[list][*]DreadOut 1.9.0 is a new build with a completely new framework.[/*][*][b]Be aware that this new release will be breaking your save game[/b]. So, if you're in the middle of playing Act 1, you may prefer to defer the update up until you've finished the game.[/*][*]This new version discarded multi-language support for the time being, it will be incorporated again later.[/*][*]This new version is asset-optimized for 32-bit system. Many 64-bit users might notice some textures' downgrade, we will resolve this issue with hi-res texture pack for 64-bit system later.[/*][*]Updates to our Steam Cloud integration so users will not be required to have a file system friendly name anymore. This eliminates cases where some users were forced to rename their Steam's display name for the sake of playing DreadOut.[/*][*]Some minor tweaks to DreadOut shaders and input system.[/*][*]a new addition of experience setting, for turning on or off clue and ghost vignette, limbo distance, Limbo message etc. so that you guys can play it at your own preferences.[/*][/list]
For you guys who wondering about DreadOut Act 2, there are some of [url=http://dreadout.com/#section=media][u]​[/u]the WIP shots[/url]. You can see more screenshots on  [url=http://dreadout.com/#section=media][u]​[/u]DreadOut website[/url].

Thank you again for all of your supports, we couldn't done this far without all of your supports.

All the best!

[b]Digital Happiness[/b]

notes.title: DreadOut version 1.5.2 Released
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
In the spirit of  the 2014 World Cup, we present Linda's 2 new unlockable tribute costumes; Brazilian and Indonesian team shirts.

[img]http://dreadout.com/1.5.2_Linda_WC_2014.jpg[/img]

Despite receiving mixed reviews, we are very glad to have such a lively community.
All of your input will certainly help us in improving many aspects of our second act.
We tried to accommodate many suggestions we've received in our current build. 
Our major update includes :
[list]
[*] Availability in German and Italian. 
[*] Added invert controller axis feature.
[*] Added support for keyboard/gamepad customization.
[*] Ability to access the gameplay options menu during a game.
[*] User interface and audio tweaking.
[*] Various in game tweaks.
[*] Some bug fixes.
[/list]
We're still working on optimizing for the 32 bit platform support as well as the OpenGL version for Mac and Linux/SteamOS platform. It will be ready on our next major update once they are stable. 
Thank you for all of your support.

Linda ♥ you :click:

notes.title: Act 2 of DreadOut will arrive as a free update.
notes.content:
Hi all.

We have been receiving many input from our fans this week. And we have decided the following:
[list]
[*]The 2nd act of DreadOut will be available as a free update (TBA) for every DreadOut purchaser on Steam.
[*]The Free-Roam mode will be a paid DLC. It is a ghost hunting mode where all of the areas from the storyline gameplay will be accessible. This mode will feature many ghosts not included in the main story.
[/list]

We will keep you updated on our further releases.

Thank you for all of your support.

Cheers,
Digital Happiness
